description: This file implements the rlc_am_status_pdu class, which handles packing and unpacking of RLC AM status Protocol Data Units (PDUs), including serialization/deserialization, merging NACKs, and managing internal state for RLC protocol operations.

classes.name: rlc_am_status_pdu
classes.description: Class managing RLC AM status PDUs, including packing, unpacking, and NACK management.

classes.name: rlc_am_status_nack
classes.description: Structure representing individual NACK entries within the status PDU.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the PDU state to default, clearing NACKs and setting header fields.

methods.name: can_be_merged
methods.description: Determines if two NACKs can be merged based on SN continuity, segment offsets, and range limits.

methods.name: push_nack
methods.description: Adds a NACK to the list, merging with previous if possible, and updates packed size.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Trims NACKs from the back to fit within a maximum packed size.

methods.name: refresh_packed_size
methods.description: Recalculates the total packed size based on current NACKs.

methods.name: nack_size
methods.description: Calculates the size of a NACK entry based on SN size and flags.

methods.name: is_control_pdu
methods.description: Checks if a given PDU buffer is a control PDU.

methods.name: unpack_12bit
methods.description: Unpacks a 12-bit SN status PDU from a byte buffer.

methods.name: unpack_18bit
methods.description: Unpacks an 18-bit SN status PDU from a byte buffer.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Dispatches to the appropriate unpack method based on SN size.

methods.name: pack_12bit
methods.description: Serializes the status PDU into a buffer using 12-bit SN encoding.

methods.name: pack_18bit
methods.description: Serializes the status PDU into a buffer using 18-bit SN encoding.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Dispatches to the appropriate pack method based on SN size.
